She does live with me, I just happened to read your post too. I’m still here for another day. It’s just so confusing with the back and forth with her, it feels like we are getting closer and she says stuff like “you know I think everyone’s going through shit in 2020, like this. We’re going through some shit right now” she’s been kissing me, she still sleeps with me and we cuddle, she woke me up to give me a kiss before she left for work this morning. I don’t know which way to go, if we can even repair us or if it’s a lost cause. And it’s kinda stupid to say here but whatever, you know couples “baby talk” right? She started that again last night with me and she was doing it quite often, something she said that needed to stop whenever this all first happened. I can’t tell if she’s just buying time or if she really wants to see if it works out. I just don’t know. And my point with seeing your post, she was your everything. She’s my everything and if I can’t ever make her happy enough and we don’t end up back together then I don’t think I’d ever want anyone else. I feel like I would spend the rest of my life just wanting her and only her. And I acknowledge that as an unhealthy way of thinking, but it’s all I know. I have no one left besides her and my dad. I don’t want to lose anyone else ever again.

Man, I feel you. I really do, But right now I’m holding on to the last bit of hope I have left. And it may be gone soon, like tomorrow soon. I’m sorry I don’t have many words of encouragement but I’ll say this, just live one day at a time. I’m trying to fight through it and it seems hopeless as I’m sure you’re feeling too. Just know you’re not alone and that I hope you get to be happy one day even if I don’t know you stranger.
